candidate_signal: business_no_burst = 1 - probability that evidence.business_trend shows an abrupt volume burst
threshold_selection: On prior development batches only, choose the threshold with highest recall among thresholds with accuracy at least 0.80. Apply that threshold unchanged to the next 50-review batch.
status: Exploratory hypothesis from development batches 0 and 1; must validate on later untouched batches before adoption.
rationale: In the first 100 development reviews, the model's business_burst probability was inversely associated with YelpZip filtered labels. This may reflect label semantics or noise and is not assumed to generalize.
